title: Ch 1.4 · Functions Lexicon
description: A 25‑round vocabulary drill on functions, domain, range, notation, and piecewise definitions. Spot the misused term, match concepts, and sort true from false — no solving, just the exact language that makes a function tick.
subtitle: Know every term cold — one wrong word and the function breaks.

rounds.explain: That is the core rule. Input → exactly one output.

rounds.explain: Yes — piecewise functions split the domain and apply a single formula at each point. Boundaries exist.
